datasets.label: SO(8) Schur checks

scheme.convention: SO(8) triality-invariant I2,I6,I8,I12 basis of the cited catalog; this differs from the vector trace/Pfaffian basis of the new QQ scan.
scheme.definition: X = Crit(P restricted to S_Y) = Spec C[S_Y] / (partial_a P)
scheme.distinction: The KLS scheme includes nilpotent structure. Its reduced support alone does not determine the jet or Macdonald series.
scheme.grading: Currents M: (q,T)=(1,1); W_d: (d,d-1); a derivative raises q by 1 and leaves T unchanged. Slice coordinates use their sl2 grades.
scheme.graph: X_tilde: partial_a P = 0, C_d(M) - W_d = 0 (before taking jets).
scheme.slice: S_Y = e + ker(ad f), with (e,h,f) an sl2 triple; S_0 = g.
